text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria, I found 
Sakura Chiyono O eating a steamed bun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Ehehe, would you care for a 
manju?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Today's batch turned out great! I happened 
to find a video of a professional 
simmering red beans, and I tried copying 
it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it amazing how just a little effort 
can make it taste this good?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's training or making Japanese 
sweets, finding room for improvement just 
fuels my desire for a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm planning to make even more tomorrow, 
so I bought a whole bunch of red beans~."
choice_data_list:
Let's make lots and eat lots so we can 
improve!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-You're right. I almost let it go 
to my head.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll hand out the steamed buns I made 
to my classmates and everyone at the 
dorms!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I hope they like it~.

The next day, Sakura Chiyono O beamed with 
satisfaction after receiving everyone's 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, repetition is definitely key! We 
gotta make a lot, and eat a lot.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Western pastries, traditional 
Japanese sweets often have less fat, so 
you can eat them with peace of mind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I love Japanese sweets! I'm 
gonna eat until my tummy is full!

The next day, Sakura Chiyono O looked 
completely content after eating lots of 
Japanese sweets.
